bio.text: Jenny Costa Honeycutt, an attorney, won the Republican nomination for South Carolina's open 1st Congressional District in the June 23, 2026 runoff, defeating state Rep. Mark Smith with about 54 percent of the vote according to unofficial results.

As of her November 2025 announcement she was on the Charleston County Council, to which she was first elected in 2018, and she was not seeking re-election to that seat in order to focus on her congressional bid.
She faces Democrat Nancy Lacore, a retired Navy vice admiral, in the November 3 general election.

sources.title: Retired Navy admiral, Charleston attorney advance in SC's 1st District contest
Charleston County Councilwoman jumps into GOP race for seat in Congress
